# Phase 4 surface-model metrics (generated by backbone.eval_surface)

Run: `experiments/2026-10-14_full_r18` (best.pt). Per-class pixel IoU, whole areas minus a 32 px (8 m) border.
Sources: `8cm` = 8 cm imagery averaged to 25 cm (training domain); `25cm` = PDOK 25 cm product (different flight); `8cm_x<f>` = 8 cm averaged to 25*f cm and resized back.
